Hi Samir — great to meet you last week, and thanks for sending the role map. Sending a quick recap and next steps so we have everything in one place.

Recap (demo highlights):
- Redwood provides production-grade inference with predictable latency and unit economics across hosted/dedicated/private deployment modes.
- Key levers: batching, caching, quantization profiles, and smart routing — measurable token-cost reductions.
- Observability + rollouts: per-route dashboards and canary/A-B rollout options for minimizing risk.

Suggested stakeholder mapping (minimal set to engage):
- Economic buyer / Sponsor: VP of Engineering or Head of Data (decision on spend and POC scope)
- Technical champion: Data Platform / ML Engineering (day-to-day owner, will run POC)
- Security/Compliance reviewer: InfoSec lead (SOC2, data residency, KMS)
- Contract/Procurement: Procurement lead (SLA, PO, payment terms)
- Legal: Counsel (DPA, liability, IP clauses)

Suggested immediate next steps:
1) Intro: Champion -> Economic buyer + Procurement + Security (30m sync) — goal: align on POC scope and timeline
2) Send required evidence: SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, KMS details (we can provide artifacts)
3) Pilot kickoff: 4-week POC with success criteria (latency SLO, cost per 1M tokens, accuracy on X benchmark)

Attached: Redwood_ROI_one-pager.pdf (back-of-envelope savings for a 6-month POC at different throughput levels).

Champion enablement (talk tracks you can share with your ML Eng lead):
- ROI: We typically see 20-40% reduction in per-token cost for retrieval-heavy workloads via caching + batching — this is before model/quantization tuning.
- Risk: We support SOC2 artifacts, private deployments (VPC), and per-route tracing for audits.
- Speed: Easy onboarding — SDKs, sample templates, and a small pilot that proves value in 4 weeks.

Proposed times for the intro sync: Tue 3/3 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 3/4 9:00-9:30 PT. Which works?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Samir / Marissa — adding a few quick champion-facing bullets that Samir can use in internal comms:

Champion one-liners for execs:
- "Redwood reduces inference cost and stabilizes latency for customer-facing models — we can test with a 4-week pilot and measure per-token savings."
- "Redwood supports private deployments and KMS integrations if we need data control for regulated flows."

Suggested ROI bullets (copy/paste into an internal email):
- Expected token cost reduction: 20-40% (depends on cache hit rate and batching).
- Example: 1M monthly API tokens at $0.015/token => baseline $15,000/month. With 30% reduction => ~$10,500/month (savings ~$4,500/month).
- Pilot goal: demonstrate >=20% reduction or show equivalent latency improvements at same spend.

Security talking points for InfoSec:
- We can provide SOC2 Type II report, data flow diagrams, and KMS/HSM integration notes within 48 hours of request.

If helpful, happy to join the intro sync to walk through technical criteria and the POC success metrics.

—Marcus
